target_claim: After choosing merely another subgroup H of order p, the proof may treat G/H as a quotient group and apply the induction hypothesis to it.
source_quote: Therefore $G$ has another subgroup of order $p$, say $H$. Now $H \cap N =1$ and by induction hypotheses  ${\rm dl}(G) \leq {\rm max}\{{\rm dl}(G/N), {\rm dl}(G/H)\} \leq {\rm max}\{|{\rm cod}(G/N)|, |{\rm cod}(G/H)|\} \leq |{\rm cod}(G)|$.
